user.title: Connected Services
user.description: Select your brand and sign in with your Toyota or SubaruConnect account

otp.title: Verification code
otp.description: Check email or phone for verification code

init.title: Polling
init.description: Refreshing reads what the servers already hold and costs the vehicle nothing. Polling wakes the vehicle to upload fresh state, which draws on its 12V battery — the setting to lower, or turn off, for a vehicle left parked and unplugged for long periods.

data_description.fetch_interval: How often to re-read the servers. Set to 0 to never refresh on a schedule; the Refresh button and toyota_na.refresh still work.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to wake the vehicle. Set to 0 to never wake it on a schedule; the Poll vehicle button and toyota_na.poll_vehicle still work.
